none: PAS NLM-7F2F93: Roman Coin: Commemorative Radiate of Valerian II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with silvered surface. Coin. Commemorative Radiate of Valerian II (255-258), issue of 258, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: DIVO[CAE]S VALERIAN[O]. Reverse description: Eagle standing right with head turned left. Reverse inscription: CONSECRATIO. Cliff reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 2.27gms, die axis: 6
